author: Arcani test fixtures
rationale: Gain ramp fixture (Story 4.4), rejected at compile (rule coupling.theta_silent): no loop, length 600 s. Theta reference: a 450 Hz carrier amplitude-modulated by the sine envelope at a fixed 4 Hz theta rate, 75 percent AM depth, fading to silence over 60 s from 240 s; gamma PAC layer: a 250 Hz sine carrier amplitude-modulated at 40 Hz with a smooth swell peaking at the 0 degree coupling phase, 100 percent AM depth, fading to silence over 60 s from 360 s, so the theta reference is silent from 300 s while the coupled gamma layer still sounds. A test fixture, not for listening.
